dispatch_note: viva-core accelerates bigraph *dispatch* ~1.27x on scalar state (viva-core's reported benchmark; cited, not re-measured here) and regresses on array-heavy state today
ode_note: viva-core does not accelerate ODE integration: it runs only processes in its native Rust registry, so a tellurium/COPASI/Python composite needs a Rust-side process port before it can run at all (viva_core.run rejected the composite: ValueError: building engine: process error: address "local:NativeGlycolysisProcess" is not module.Class)
viva_hybrid_note: viva-hybrid is a rigorous negative result: ~2x over numba, with no regime that is both >=5x and faithful to exact SSA
caveat: Best-effort spike, not CI-gated (no Rust toolchain in the pipeline). The dispatch (~1.27x) and viva-hybrid (~2x) figures are cited from those projects' own benchmarks; only the native-composite ODE attempt is measured in this workspace.
